name: Duchess, Wayward Tavernkeep
oracle_text:
Hunters for Hire — Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, put a quest counter on it.
{1}, Remove a quest counter from a permanent you control: Create a Junk token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.")
blocked_sentences: {1}, Remove a quest counter from a permanent you control: Create a Junk token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.")

needs.what: a counter kind on the `remove_counters_from_among` cost, e.g. {"mana": "{1}", "remove_counters_from_among": {"count": 1, "counter": "quest"}}, so the payer removes a counter of THAT kind from a permanent they control, with payability checked against counters of that kind only
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `remove_counters_from_among` cost (costs._counter_removal_pool / counter_removal.remove_counters_one_at_a_time) removes a counter of any kind, so a permanent carrying a quest and a +1/+1 counter could pay with the +1/+1; `has_counters: "quest"` on its selector only narrows which permanents are offered, not which kind comes off; the `remove_counters` cost names a kind but reads only the source. The trigger line (deals_combat_damage_to_player, controller you, add_counters quest on subject) and junk_token are both expressible
